description: This PHP source file defines the class 'UpgradeRemoval', which provides functionality for removing files and directories during a system upgrade process in the SuiteCRM project. It supports custom extensions by allowing subclasses to specify files to remove and handles backup operations.

classes.name: UpgradeRemoval
classes.description: A base class facilitating file removal during upgrade processes, including backup features and extension points for custom removal logic.

methods.name: getFilesToRemove
methods.description: Returns an array of files/directories to be removed for a specific version. Designed to be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: processFilesToRemove
methods.description: Handles the removal of specified files/directories, including backing them up beforehand.

methods.name: backup
methods.description: Backs up a given file or directory to 'custom/backup' directory before removal.
